topic: Week 4 recap: 5 Claude lessons for beginners in 60 seconds
post:
Four weeks of learning Claude. Still no tech background needed. 🎓
Here's everything from week 4, in 60 seconds.

1️⃣ Tokens and the context window
AI reads text in small chunks called tokens. The context window is Claude's "working memory", like a desk it works at.

2️⃣ Receipts to expense report
Put receipts in one folder, share only that folder with Cowork, and ask for an Excel report. Then spot-check it.

3️⃣ Build a web page, no code
A simple web page is just a file. Describe it in plain English and Claude Code creates it.

4️⃣ The "tough reviewer" prompt
Give Claude a role: a skeptical manager. Ask for the 3 biggest weaknesses, and say "don't rewrite it for me."

5️⃣ Plugins
Install skills, connectors and helper agents in one step from Customize > Plugins. You connect each app yourself.

Why it matters:
Week 4 was about going from "chatting with AI" to building real things with it: reports, pages, and your own toolkit. 🧰

Your challenge this week: run the tough reviewer prompt on something you'll present.

Which lesson will you try first? 👇

Follow me: I'm teaching one Claude skill a day, no tech background needed.
